heading: A clear view of your inventory.
description: Know what you have, where it is, and what needs your attention.
warehousesDescription: Manage locations and the inventory stored in each warehouse.
dashboardDescription: Understand stock levels and see your highest and lowest quantities.
usersDescription: Control team access with clear roles and secure sessions.

roleDescription.Admin: Manage users and logs, update inventory, prepare supplier requests, and send notifications.
roleDescription.Management: Update warehouses and items, prepare supplier requests, and view reports.
roleDescription.Auditor: View inventory, dashboards, reports, supplier requests, and personal notifications. Cannot change records.
logsDescription: Review recent application requests and events.
supplierOrdersDescription: Prepare requests and track local notification delivery.
localDeliveryNotice: Delivery is local test recording only. No supplier is contacted.
notificationsDescription: Messages for you, delivered here as they arrive.
notificationChannelNote: Email needs an SMTP account. SMS needs an Android phone gateway on the same local network. Carrier charges may apply.

notificationInvalid: Choose a recipient, enter a title and message, and check the phone number if using SMS.
